summary: An option within a RadioButtonGroup that lets users select exactly one choice from a visible set.

alternatives.when: Users can select more than one option, or each option is an independent choice.
Users choose one option from a very long list.
Users choose one option from a highly visible range.

pitfalls: Render each RadioButton inside a RadioButtonGroup and control selection with the group's value and onChange; a RadioButton is checked only when its value matches the group value, and outside a group it logs a context error and cannot be checked.
Give RadioButtonGroup a legend that describes the choice, and set size, required and validation error on the group; RadioButton size, error and warning are deprecated.
progressiveDisclosure is ignored when RadioButtonGroup is inline; Carbon recommends keeping revealed content limited and using a different pattern for larger amounts.
Collapsed progressiveDisclosure content stays mounted but hidden, so values entered in revealed fields persist after another option is selected; clear or ignore them on submit if needed.
Carbon supports disabled radio buttons, but the Design System does not generally recommend them.

examples.description: Reveal a follow-up field beneath the selected option in a controlled RadioButtonGroup.
